records.note: An archived ParcelPanel JRS Express page offered it to try, the airbill and the branch code joined by a hyphen. JRS Express's tracker answers it as a parcel accepted at a Muntinlupa branch, sent through the head office and released at the San Mateo, Isabela branch.

The 'Find your tracking number' image of JRS Express's former tracking page, an official receipt with the airbill number marked; the receipt prints branch code 161 beside it, and the tracker needs both. The capture was opened by rendering it in a browser.
The example the current tracking page's field prints, airbill first and the branch code after the hyphen. The tracker holds a shipment under it, so it is also a real reference.
